name: QueueItem
description: A single transaction item in a queue

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the queue item

Key.description: Unique GUID key for the queue item

QueueDefinitionId.description: ID of the queue this item belongs to

Status.description: Current processing status of the queue item

ReviewStatus.description: Manual review status for failed items

Priority.description: Processing priority of the queue item

Reference.description: Optional unique reference string for idempotency

SpecificContent.description: Custom key-value payload data for the queue item

Output.description: Output data written by the robot after processing

CreationTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the item was added to the queue

RetryNumber.description: Number of times this item has been retried

DueDate.description: Optional deadline for processing the item
